name: Omnisend MCP
description: Get instant answers from your Omnisend data. Ask about campaign performance, automation drop-offs, and subscriber trends. Understand what's working and what to fix next, without touching a report.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Omnisend MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Omnisend MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.omnisend.com/v2/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Omnisend MCP MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Omnisend MCP provides these MCP tools: omnisend_create, omnisend_delete, omnisend_query, omnisend_reference, omnisend_search, omnisend_tool_schema, and omnisend_update.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Omnisend MCP?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Omnisend MCP in marketing-seo on the Manufact MCP catalog include Buzzfy, Airefs AI Visibility, TalkGenAI, RankControl, and attentive-mcp-server.

_published_faq.name: Does Omnisend MCP MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Omnisend MCP requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Omnisend MCP is developed by Omnisend. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
